title: Low-Resource, High-Impact: Building Corpora for Inclusive Language Technologies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of NLP and vision-language models across low-resource languages and specific regional dialects (e.g., Arabic dialects, Sorbian, Ukrainian, Bhojpuri, Maasai) using custom benchmarks, parallel sentence mining, and language identification datasets.
Assessing vision-language models using a culturally grounded and dialect-sensitive dataset (the JEEM benchmark) to evaluate performance on regionally authentic content and visual question answering.
Reviewing and addressing the inherent social biases of Large Language Models (LLMs) when utilized for data annotation and synthetic data generation in low-resource settings.
